final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT advancedbehavior.translink AS translink, transactionrecord.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior INNER JOIN transactionrecord ON transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink WHERE advancedbehavior.peercorr > 0.149 GROUP BY advancedbehavior.translink, transactionrecord.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT order_type_mix, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1 GROUP BY order_type_mix) SELECT step1.translink, step1.order_type_mix, step1.record_count, 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count FROM step1 INNER JOIN step2 ON step1.order_type_mix = step2.order_type_mix ORDER BY 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count DESC LIMIT 10
